_meta.role: AI/ML Imaging Data Scientist - Personalized Healthcare (Medical Imaging)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built a medical imaging pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with U-Net segmentation evaluated on Dice and IoU, and a microscopic image analysis pipeline reaching PSNR 86. Experienced in machine learning, computer vision and transformer fine-tuning in Python and PyTorch, with Git, GitLab, JupyterHub and SLURM workflows.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.
Evaluated trade-offs between model efficiency and task performance for edge deployment constraints.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster.
Achieved up to 10.49× speedup with 12 slave processes; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.
